comment: Coverage floors, checked by tests/coverage_merge.js --check (run by ./run-coverage.sh). Falling below any of these fails the run. Each is what a run achieved less a margin of 1 of a point, because a job skipped for want of a service takes its lines with it; --write-floors applies that margin. Raise them deliberately when coverage improves; never lower one without saying in the commit message what stopped being tested.
